review_text: I recently visited Coffee Hub, and it quickly became my go-to spot! The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, making it the perfect place to relax or get some work done. The coffee is absolutely amazing—rich, flavorful, and brewed to perfection. Their menu has a wide variety of options, from classic espressos to unique specialty drinks, and each cup is crafted with care. The pastries and snacks were equally delicious, a perfect complement to the coffee. The staff was friendly and welcoming, and the service was excellent. Whether you’re looking for a quiet place to unwind or a spot to meet friends, Delicious Food & Amazing Coffee! ☕️ The food and coffee at Coffee Hub are absolutely fantastic! Every dish is flavorful, and the coffee is brewed to perfection. Whether you’re here for a meal or just a quick coffee break, you’re in for a treat. I’ll definitely be coming back for more! Coffee Hub is the place to be. Highly recommended!

Delicious foods..We ordered spam and tapa. Portion servings are okay but food preparation really took a lot of time; which is why, by the time it was served, we were famished and forgot to take pictures 😋😋😋 Staff are also friendly. By the way this place is located within Davao Hub; hence, this is where we prepared (since it's self service 😅) and ate the free continental breakfast ha ha ha. Anyways, I really love the decorations and interior design since it made the place homey, specially in the morning. Ideal place to have some chit chat and just chill 😁 Location is also accessible since it's situated in downtown Davao.

It's quiet, with fast wifi. The space is small with very friendly service. The food is filling and great drinks. Definitely a great place to stay in if you want to study out, I'd love to keep coming back here to study, as well as eat and drink.

The “C” in Coffee Hub stands for cozy. 😙☕️ The place was small and simple. It had a patio for alfresco diners. In total, it can accommodate 20 customers. Moreover, the coffee shop had good choice of furniture; it looked and felt spacious despite its size. The best part: Coffee Hub’s comfort room. It was clean and hygienic, complete with bidet, hand soap, and tissue. It earned my vote. I’d say Coffee Hub is the best place for productivity and practicality. It offers coffee and non-caffeine drinks, and meals at reasonable prices (P.S. dirty matcha was good). Every order entitles a customer to 3 hours of wifi connection. Furthermore, it is important to note that the management imposes a 3-hour rule to discourage over-staying. They require customers to make an additional order to extend their stay. Lastly, parking spaces are limited.

Great place for students, working professionals, and groups of friends. Tasty caramel macchiato. High-speed internet connection. Convenient, available 24/7, accessible— location is in downtown, and very accomodating staff. 4/5 stars, carbonara and mocha cake need to improve.

What a huge letdown. A disappointing experience. I went there at around 2 AM. They have no food to serve, absolutely no food at all. As for the drinks, it was so hard to choose something to my liking because they have no decaf, no oat milk, no almond milk, their matcha is not pure matcha, their hot chocolate is powdered (not the authentic cocoa). I ended up ordering a basic americano. Edit: I'm drinking my Americano as I'm typing. This coffee tastes so bad! Ugh!
Well price and very convenient with the long hours they are open. Food and coffee was okay. Atmosphere is a little cramped and the design is a bit busy. Overall nice place.

This place is a great spot for students who need a quiet place to study, especially since it’s open 24 hours. The coffee is really good, and the cozy atmosphere makes it easy to focus. I also appreciate that every table has a socket for charging, very convenient! The prices are affordable too, which is perfect for those on a budget. Definitely a nice place to spend some productive time.

Food is okay, but music is kinda loud. This is a caveat you are going to visit here to work/focus. I loved the wifi and the sockets everywhere though. If you will come here to have chitchats with friends or just spend some me time, then this place is okay.

Love their mango frappe. It has right amount of sweetness. They also have free wifi for their customers. Internet speed ranges from 1-4mbps. Atmosphere is pretty decent. Place is cold and they play low volume music.

I've been coming back to Coffee Hub time and time again. Every time, it really is enjoyable. I love the ala carte meals that they have. The sandwiches–both tuna and chicken–are very delicious as well. I have tried many drinks in my numerous visits, but I think my top favorites are the Matcha Oreo Frappe, and the Strawberry Fruit Juice (Or tea, I'm probably wrong). This place is definitely a must try.
